contract: GMLI China M2 official-source candidate v2
purpose: Replace the opaque legacy China stitch prospectively with a reproducible PBoC-native M2 history while preserving the existing GMLI seven-region architecture and evaluating the impact before any Core promotion.

methodology_policy.candidate_rule: Treat this as a new versioned official-source candidate. Do not call it the missing historical exact rerun.
preferred_source_order: 2015 onward accounting levels: PBoC Statistics -> year -> Money and Banking Statistics -> Money Supply -> HTML
2015 published growth: exact-month central PBoC Financial Statistics Reports
2014 comparable-base accounting seed: implied from each precise 2015 HTML level and the same month's official published 2015 M2 YoY

history_contract.precision_history: 2015 onward uses official Money Supply table values in RMB 100 million directly.
history_contract.seed_year_2014_role: ACCOUNTING_SEED_ONLY. The 2014 rows are implied comparable-base levels, not claimed observed 2014 stock values.
history_contract.seed_reason: The historical 2014 Money Supply HTML target is dead and the old archive is inconsistent. Rather than guess or use a proxy, derive only the prior-year comparable accounting base required for 2015 weights from two official PBoC published components.
history_contract.signal_semantics: For 2015, derived China YoY from the implied comparable base equals the exact-month official PBoC published YoY by construction. From 2016 onward, YoY is calculated from precision PBoC HTML levels.
history_contract.raw_byte_policy: Preserve the Statistics index and each 2015+ Money Supply HTML payload. Preserve each accepted 2015 Financial Statistics article payload and SHA-256 used to construct the comparable-base seed.
history_contract.no_proxy_rule: No OECD, commercial vendor, mirror or reconstructed legacy series may fill the seed.
history_contract.honesty_rule: Never describe the implied 2014 comparable base as an observed 2014 Money Supply series or as recovered historical frozen bytes.

published_growth_anchor.source: Official central PBoC 2015-01 Financial Statistics Report
published_growth_anchor.note: The report explicitly says January 2015 M2 YoY is calculated on a comparable basis.

known_breaks.description: PBoC improved the money-market-fund component of money supply statistics and retrospectively revised 2017 M2 growth for comparability. The official level tables remain the V2 accounting history; the break is explicitly recorded.
e-CNY was added to M0; PBoC states revised M1/M2 growth rates were not materially changed.
PBoC revised M1 definition; this contract uses M2 and records the break for provenance only.

current_cross_check.note: Rounded report values are a cross-check only for the 2015+ precision history.

promotion_policy: A complete official V2 series may be used to construct a new Money candidate and rerun the locked transmission evaluation. Promotion, if justified, is a new version decision and does not alter the historical fact that the old v1.8b exact rerun was impossible.
